mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving laboratory’s quiet moment was most worthwhile: the folded limbs return to view, giving the discovery a restrained ending.

leastWorthwhile.text: The completed board after the ending added little for me; there were no goals or decisions to make.

surprise.text: I was struck by how quietly the story ended, with the laboratory team saying nothing for a while.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to assess for arbitrary choices.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if there were another chapter, to learn what the laboratory finds, though this ending gives the story a satisfying pause.
